symptoms: Olive-green to velvety dark brown circular spots on leaf surfaces
Lesions turn corky, dark, and puckered as leaves age
Premature yellowing and leaf shedding in mid-summer
Corky, scabby brown crusts on developing apple fruits
risk_factors: Cool, wet spring weather during bud break and petal fall (13-24°C)
Overwintering fungal perithecia on fallen leaf litter
prevention: Rake and shred or compost fallen apple leaves in autumn to eliminate primary inoculum
Plant scab-resistant apple cultivars (e.g. Liberty, Enterprise, GoldRush)
Prune tree canopy in winter for maximum sunlight penetration
recommended_actions: Apply preventative sulfur or captan sprays from green tip through petal fall
